createTables.messages: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS messages ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, jid TEXT NOT NULL, fromMe INTEGER NOT NULL, timestamp INTEGER NOT NULL, content TEXT, messageJson TEXT NOT NULL, createdAt INTEGER DEFAULT (strftime('%s', 'now')) )
createTables.messagesIndex: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_messages_jid ON messages(jid)
createTables.messagesTimestampIndex: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_messages_timestamp ON messages(timestamp)
createTables.chats: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS chats ( jid TEXT PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, unreadCount INTEGER DEFAULT 0, lastMessageTimestamp INTEGER, lastMessageText TEXT, archived INTEGER DEFAULT 0, createdAt INTEGER DEFAULT (strftime('%s', 'now')) )
createTables.contacts: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS contacts ( jid TEXT PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, pushName TEXT, profilePictureUrl TEXT, createdAt INTEGER DEFAULT (strftime('%s', 'now')) )
createTables.groupMetadata: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS group_metadata ( jid TEXT PRIMARY KEY, metadataJson TEXT NOT NULL, groupLink TEXT, updatedAt INTEGER DEFAULT (strftime('%s', 'now')) )
createTables.presences: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS presences ( jid TEXT PRIMARY KEY, presence TEXT, lastSeen INTEGER, updatedAt INTEGER DEFAULT (strftime('%s', 'now')) )
createTables.labels: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS labels ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, color INTEGER, deleted INTEGER DEFAULT 0 )
createTables.labelAssociations: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS label_associations ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, labelId TEXT NOT NULL, chatId TEXT, messageId TEXT, type TEXT, FOREIGN KEY(labelId) REFERENCES labels(id) )
createTables.customMessages: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS custom_messages ( jid TEXT NOT NULL, type TEXT NOT NULL, message TEXT NOT NULL, updatedAt INTEGER DEFAULT (strftime('%s', 'now')), PRIMARY KEY(jid, type) )
createTables.customMessagesIndex: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_custom_messages_jid ON custom_messages(jid)
createTables.messageCounts: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS message_counts ( groupJid TEXT NOT NULL, userJid TEXT NOT NULL, count INTEGER DEFAULT 0, lastActive INTEGER DEFAULT (strftime('%s', 'now')), PRIMARY KEY(groupJid, userJid) )
createTables.messageCountsIndex: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_message_counts_group ON message_counts(groupJid, count DESC)
createTables.vars: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS vars ( key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT NOT NULL, updatedAt INTEGER DEFAULT (strftime('%s', 'now')) )
createTables.groupSettings: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS group_settings ( jid TEXT NOT NULL, feature TEXT NOT NULL, enabled INTEGER DEFAULT 0, action TEXT, data TEXT, updatedAt INTEGER DEFAULT (strftime('%s', 'now')), PRIMARY KEY(jid, feature) )
createTables.filters: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS filters ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, jid TEXT NOT NULL, pattern TEXT NOT NULL, response TEXT NOT NULL, isMedia INTEGER DEFAULT 0, createdAt INTEGER DEFAULT (strftime('%s', 'now')) )
createTables.filtersIndex: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_filters_jid ON filters(jid)
createTables.grants: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS grants ( jid TEXT NOT NULL, command TEXT NOT NULL, grantedAt INTEGER DEFAULT (strftime('%s', 'now')), PRIMARY KEY(jid, command) )
createTables.afk: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS afk ( jid TEXT PRIMARY KEY, reason TEXT NOT NULL, since INTEGER DEFAULT (strftime('%s', 'now')) )
createTables.jobs: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS jobs ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, type TEXT NOT NULL, jid TEXT NOT NULL, runAt INTEGER NOT NULL, recurrence TEXT, payload TEXT, status TEXT DEFAULT 'pending', createdBy TEXT, createdAt INTEGER DEFAULT (strftime('%s', 'now')) )
createTables.jobsIndex: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_jobs_status_runAt ON jobs(status, runAt)
createTables.stickerCmds: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sticker_cmds ( hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY, command TEXT NOT NULL, createdBy TEXT, createdAt INTEGER DEFAULT (strftime('%s', 'now')) )

selectAllMessages: SELECT * FROM messages ORDER BY timestamp DESC
updateContactProfilePicture: UPDATE contacts SET profilePictureUrl = ? WHERE jid = ?
insertMessage: INSERT OR REPLACE INTO messages (id, jid, fromMe, timestamp, content, messageJson) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
updateMessageText: UPDATE messages SET content = ? WHERE id = ?
upsertChatFromMessage: INSERT INTO chats (jid, lastMessageTimestamp, lastMessageText) VALUES (?, ?, ?) ON CONFLICT(jid) DO UPDATE SET lastMessageTimestamp = excluded.lastMessageTimestamp, lastMessageText = excluded.lastMessageText
updateChat: UPDATE chats SET name = COALESCE(?, name), unreadCount = COALESCE(?, unreadCount), archived = COALESCE(?, archived) WHERE jid = ?
insertContact: INSERT OR REPLACE INTO contacts (jid, name, pushName) VALUES (?, ?, ?)
selectMessagesByJid: SELECT * FROM messages WHERE jid = ? ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT ?
selectMessagesByJidBefore: SELECT * FROM messages WHERE jid = ? AND timestamp < ? ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT ?
selectMessagesByJidAfter: SELECT * FROM messages WHERE jid = ? AND timestamp > ? ORDER BY timestamp ASC LIMIT ?
selectMostRecentMessage: SELECT * FROM messages WHERE jid = ? ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1
selectAllChats: SELECT * FROM chats ORDER BY lastMessageTimestamp DESC
selectGroupMetadata: SELECT metadataJson, groupLink FROM group_metadata WHERE jid = ?
selectGroupLink: SELECT groupLink FROM group_metadata WHERE jid = ?
updateGroupLink: UPDATE group_metadata SET groupLink = ?, updatedAt = (strftime('%s', 'now')) WHERE jid = ?
upsertGroupMetadata: INSERT INTO group_metadata (jid, metadataJson, groupLink, updatedAt) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?) ON CONFLICT(jid) DO UPDATE SET metadataJson = excluded.metadataJson, groupLink = COALESCE(excluded.groupLink, group_metadata.groupLink), updatedAt = excluded.updatedAt
selectPresence: SELECT presence, lastSeen FROM presences WHERE jid = ?
upsertPresence: INSERT OR REPLACE INTO presences (jid, presence, lastSeen, updatedAt) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)
selectLabelById: SELECT * FROM labels WHERE id = ? AND deleted = 0
insertLabel: INSERT OR REPLACE INTO labels (id, name, color, deleted) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)
updateLabel: UPDATE labels SET name = ?, color = ?, deleted = ? WHERE id = ?
selectLabelAssociations: SELECT * FROM label_associations WHERE (chatId = ? OR messageId = ?) AND labelId = ?
insertLabelAssociation: INSERT OR REPLACE INTO label_associations (id, labelId, chatId, messageId, type) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
insertChatRaw: INSERT OR REPLACE INTO chats (jid, name, unreadCount, lastMessageTimestamp, lastMessageText, archived, createdAt) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
insertContactRaw: INSERT OR REPLACE INTO contacts (jid, name, pushName, profilePictureUrl, createdAt) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
insertMessageRaw: INSERT OR REPLACE INTO messages (id, jid, fromMe, timestamp, content, messageJson, createdAt) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
insertGroupMetadataRaw: INSERT INTO group_metadata (jid, metadataJson, groupLink, updatedAt) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?) ON CONFLICT(jid) DO UPDATE SET metadataJson = excluded.metadataJson, groupLink = COALESCE(excluded.groupLink, group_metadata.groupLink), updatedAt = excluded.updatedAt
insertPresenceRaw: INSERT OR REPLACE INTO presences (jid, presence, lastSeen, updatedAt) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)
insertLabelRaw: INSERT OR REPLACE INTO labels (id, name, color, deleted) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)
insertLabelAssociationRaw: INSERT OR REPLACE INTO label_associations (id, labelId, chatId, messageId, type) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
insertCustomMessage: INSERT INTO custom_messages (jid, type, message, updatedAt) VALUES (?, ?, ?, strftime('%s', 'now')) ON CONFLICT(jid, type) DO UPDATE SET message = excluded.message, updatedAt = excluded.updatedAt
upsertCustomMessage: INSERT INTO custom_messages (jid, type, message, updatedAt) VALUES (?, ?, ?, strftime('%s', 'now')) ON CONFLICT(jid, type) DO UPDATE SET message = excluded.message, updatedAt = excluded.updatedAt
selectCustomMessage: SELECT * FROM custom_messages WHERE jid = ? AND type = ?
selectCustomMessageByJidAndType: SELECT * FROM custom_messages WHERE jid = ? AND type = ?
selectAllCustomMessagesByJid: SELECT * FROM custom_messages WHERE jid = ? ORDER BY type ASC
selectAllCustomMessages: SELECT * FROM custom_messages ORDER BY jid ASC, type ASC
deleteCustomMessageByJidAndType: DELETE FROM custom_messages WHERE jid = ? AND type = ?
deleteCustomMessage: DELETE FROM custom_messages WHERE jid = ? AND type = ?
incrementMessageCount: INSERT INTO message_counts (groupJid, userJid, count, lastActive) VALUES (?, ?, 1, strftime('%s', 'now')) ON CONFLICT(groupJid, userJid) DO UPDATE SET count = count + 1, lastActive = excluded.lastActive
selectTopMembers: SELECT userJid, count, lastActive FROM message_counts WHERE groupJid = ? ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT ?
selectUserMessageCount: SELECT count FROM message_counts WHERE groupJid = ? AND userJid = ?
selectAllGroupMessageCounts: SELECT userJid, count FROM message_counts WHERE groupJid = ?
insertMessageCountRaw: INSERT OR REPLACE INTO message_counts (groupJid, userJid, count, lastActive) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)
selectVar: SELECT value FROM vars WHERE key = ?
selectAllVars: SELECT key, value, updatedAt FROM vars ORDER BY key ASC
upsertVar: INSERT INTO vars (key, value, updatedAt) VALUES (?, ?, strftime('%s', 'now')) ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET value = excluded.value, updatedAt = excluded.updatedAt
selectGroupSetting: SELECT * FROM group_settings WHERE jid = ? AND feature = ?
upsertGroupSetting: INSERT INTO group_settings (jid, feature, enabled, action, data, updatedAt) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, strftime('%s', 'now')) ON CONFLICT(jid, feature) DO UPDATE SET enabled = excluded.enabled, action = excluded.action, data = excluded.data, updatedAt = excluded.updatedAt
deleteGroupSetting: DELETE FROM group_settings WHERE jid = ? AND feature = ?
selectFiltersByJid: SELECT * FROM filters WHERE jid = ? OR jid = 'global' ORDER BY id ASC
selectFilter: SELECT * FROM filters WHERE jid = ? AND pattern = ?
insertFilter: INSERT INTO filters (jid, pattern, response, isMedia, createdAt) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, strftime('%s', 'now'))
deleteFilter: DELETE FROM filters WHERE jid = ? AND pattern = ?
selectGrant: SELECT * FROM grants WHERE (jid = ? OR jid = ?) AND (command = ? OR command = 'all')
selectAllGrants: SELECT * FROM grants ORDER BY jid ASC
selectGrantsByJid: SELECT command, grantedAt FROM grants WHERE jid = ?
insertGrant: INSERT OR REPLACE INTO grants (jid, command, grantedAt) VALUES (?, ?, strftime('%s', 'now'))
deleteGrant: DELETE FROM grants WHERE jid = ? AND (command = ? OR ? = 'all')
insertAfk: INSERT OR REPLACE INTO afk (jid, reason, since) VALUES (?, ?, strftime('%s', 'now'))
selectPendingJobs: SELECT * FROM jobs WHERE status = 'pending' AND runAt <= ? ORDER BY runAt ASC LIMIT 20
insertJob: INSERT INTO jobs (type, jid, runAt, recurrence, payload, createdBy) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
updateJobStatus: UPDATE jobs SET status = ? WHERE id = ?
updateJobRunAt: UPDATE jobs SET runAt = ?, status = 'pending' WHERE id = ?
selectJobsByJidOrType: SELECT * FROM jobs WHERE (jid = ? OR ? = '') AND (type = ? OR ? = '') AND status = 'pending' ORDER BY runAt ASC
selectAllStickerCmds: SELECT * FROM sticker_cmds ORDER BY createdAt DESC
insertStickerCmd: INSERT OR REPLACE INTO sticker_cmds (hash, command, createdBy, createdAt) VALUES (?, ?, ?, strftime('%s', 'now'))
